locked.title: Coming soon
locked.description: A new chapter opens here as the Academy grows.

error.title: Couldn't load your progress
error.description: Something went wrong reaching the server. Check your connection and try again.

video.comingSoon: The video is on its way. You can start now.

houston-tour.title: Take a tour of Houston
houston-tour.description: See where everything lives, in under a minute.

team.body: Your AI Employees live here. Open one any time to see what it's working on.

board.body: This is your AI Employee's board. Every task you give them shows up here, with where it stands.

newTask.body: Use New task whenever you need something done. Your AI Employee takes it from there.

aiModels.body: AI Models is where you connect your AI, or switch to another one.

integrations.body: Integrations connect the apps you already use, like Gmail or Slack, so your AI Employees can work in them.

skills.body: Skills are know-how your AI Employees share. Add one and all of them can use it.

academy.body: And this is the Academy. Come back any time to learn more and level up.

employee-email.title: Have an AI Employee email you
employee-email.description: Connect your email and get a real email from your AI Employee.

intro.title: Your AI Employee, doing real work
intro.body: Connect your email, pick an AI Employee, and ask it to email you. It takes about a minute.

connect.title: Connect your email
connect.body: Pick the email you use. You can manage it any time in Integrations.
connect.unavailable: Email apps aren't available on this Houston yet.

sender.title: Who should email you?
sender.body: Pick the AI Employee that sends it.

empty.title: Hire your first AI Employee
empty.body: You need an AI Employee to send the email. Hire one and this lesson picks right up.
empty.askAdmin: Your team has no AI Employees yet. Ask a workspace admin to add one, then come back.

ask.body: Your request is ready. Press Send to give it to your AI Employee.
ask.request: Send me a short, friendly hello email at my own email address, using {{app}}.
ask.requestAnyApp: Send me a short, friendly hello email at my own email address.

watch.body: Your AI Employee is on it. Check your inbox.
